text.ko: 업종 평균 수준. 강점: 자기자본이익률(ROE) 10.7%. 약점: 잉여현금흐름 마진 -9.2%.
text.en: About average for its sector. Strength: Return on equity 10.7%. Weakness: Free cash flow margin -9.2%.

text.en: Strong within its sector. Strength: Revenue growth consistency 100%. Weakness: 3-yr free cash flow growth -50.0%.

text.en: About average for its sector. Strength: Credit loss allowance ratio 1.0%. Weakness: Liabilities to equity 185.6%.

text.ko: 업종 내 매우 약함. 약점: 잉여현금흐름 수익률 -0.9%.
text.en: Very weak within its sector. Weakness: Free cash flow yield -0.9%.

text.ko: 현재 경제 환경이 이 업종에 불리한 편이에요. 주요 요인: 금리 상승 국면 (불리).
text.en: The current economy tends to work against this sector. Main factor: rising rates (hurts).
